title: Orthogonal isometric embeddings of complementary dimensions give orthogonal coordinates on ℝ^{n+k}
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝ^k. Then (a) every x ∈ ℝ^{n+k} can be written as x = ιv + ι'w with v ∈ ℝⁿ and w ∈ ℝ^k, and (b) ‖ιv + ι'w‖² = ‖v‖² + ‖w‖² for all v ∈ ℝⁿ and w ∈ ℝ^k.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ∃ v : Euclid n, ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) ∧ ∀ (v : Euclid n) (w : Euclid k), ‖ι v + ι' w‖ ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2
